1000: SLOTTBL_CHK: tail of a routine from the missing half (entered from 0FFxH):
test SLOT_TBL[A]; clean up stack and continue at X_0FE9 or SLOT_INC_CHK.
1028: SLOTREC_PHASE: update the 9-byte per-slot record from PHASE_CODE_HI.
1358: PLOT_OUT: strip-chart output mode. Emits CR, LF then 80 columns with ' ' / '!' / '"' / '#'
marking the two values from PLOT_VALUES.
1708: PRTBUF_GET: pull next char from the print buffer (PRTBUF_PTR walks down to PRTBUF).
1723: REPORT_TASK: sequence the periodic data report over the serial port (RPT_STATE 0..8,
0FEH = idle, 0FFH = armed). Items are formatted by X_189B / X_1878 in the missing half.
0000: Reset vector. Interrupts off, jump to INIT.
0004: Table of six 4-byte packed-BCD constants (little-endian, LS byte first).
BCD_K_00080980 and BCD_K_00000110 are passed to X_0EC1 (missing half).
001C: PULSE_PB2: pulse bit 2 of 8155#2 port B.
PULSE_PB:  pulse the bits set in A on 8155#2 port B (XOR twice = toggle out and back).
The 8155 output port latch is readable, so XRA M / MOV M,A works on the port.
0028: CPY_GRI_TO_TOA: copy the 4-byte GRI_BCD into CUR_TOA (HL=GRI_BCD, BC=CUR_TOA).
CPY4_TO_TOA:    copy 4 bytes from (HL) into CUR_TOA.
0034: Entered only from the EI/NOP/DI window inside WAIT_SAMPLE, so the stack holds
[ret into WAIT_SAMPLE][ret to WAIT_SAMPLE's caller]. The trailing POP B / RET discards
the first and returns to the main-loop caller with A = B = PIO2_PC rotated left twice.
Sets PIO1_PC bit 0 (busy) and acknowledges the receiver with a pulse on PIO2_PB bit 5.
0072: INIT: cold start. Program the 8251 USART (mode 0DAH = async x16, 7 data, odd parity,
2 stop; command 37H = TxEN DTR RxE ER RTS), set SP, program both 8155s and the 8279,
SIM 1DH = enable RST 6.5 only, clear RAM 6F00-70FB, read the front-panel switches,
derive SLOT_COUNT from the GRI and fall into the acquisition sequence.
012D: ACQ_START: (re)start master acquisition. Reached again whenever tracking is lost.
0163: SEARCH_LOOP: search for the master phase code, alternating REC_MASTER / REC_SEC targets.
01B0: MASTER_FOUND: master locked. Slot 0 flags = C8H, then 20 settle passes (SETTLE_CNT).
021B: TRACK_LOOP: steady-state tracking loop, one pass per GRI epoch.
023D: TRACK_NEXT_SLOT: advance SLOT_IDX (wraps at SLOT_COUNT); skip slots without bit 7.
0262: SLOT_PROCESS: load slot record into CUR_REC and dispatch on TRACK_STATE:
bit7 -> SLOT_TRACKING, bit6 -> SLOT_ACQUIRE, else initial window search.
031D: SLOT_TRACKING: state 80H. Verify the pulse group; count misses (MISS_CNT / MISS_LIMIT).
0393: SLOT_ACQUIRE: state 40H. Read the phase code, accumulate pulse counts, decide lock (state 80H).
0412: QUAL_UPDATE: count zero bits in each nibble of PHASE_CODE into QUAL_LO/QUAL_HI (saturate at 40H).
0445: QUAL_CHECK: carry set if either QUAL counter < 28H (poor signal).
0459: WAIT_SAMPLE: idle/background loop. Opens a one-instruction interrupt window (EI NOP DI);
when RST 6.5 fires the ISR returns directly to WAIT_SAMPLE's caller (see RST65_ISR).
Between windows: optional expansion ROM hook at 2000H (signature 0A5H), serial receive,
serial transmit, and, if RST 7.5 latched (RIM bit 6), the periodic tick tasks.
049B: WAIT_EPOCH: wait for a sample whose status (PIO2_PC bit 2, seen as bit 4 after RLC RLC) is set.
04AE: SHIFT_IN16: clock 8 bits out of the receiver shift register via PIO2_PB bit 4.
PIO2_PC bit 4 -> B (phase-code stream), bit 3 -> C (second stream). Returns A = B.
04D1: READ_PHASE: SHIFT_IN16 then XOR with PHASE_REF -> PHASE_CODE (2 bytes).
04E1: GET_SLOT_FLAGS: A = SLOT_FLAGS[SLOT_IDX].  GET_FLAGS_A: A = SLOT_FLAGS[A].
04EB: GET_SLOT_REC: HL -> 25-byte station record for SLOT_IDX.
050B: MUL9_INDEX: A = (HL + 9*A). Patched: the original x10 body survives at OLD_MUL10.
0515: OLD_MUL10: dead code left by an in-place patch (PUSH B / RLC / MOV C,A / RLC / RLC / ADD C).
0522: LOAD_CUR_REC: CUR_FLAGS = slot flags; copy the slot's 25-byte record into CUR_REC.
0533: OLD_LOAD_REC: dead code left by an in-place patch (copied in the opposite direction).
0553: COUNT_TRACKED: B = number of set bits in TRACK_MASK.
057A: RESET_PULSES: clear pulse list and reset CUR_PULSE_PTR to CUR_PULSES.
0584: CLEAR_PULSES: zero 17 bytes from CUR_NPULSE (falls into FILL_ZERO in the missing half).
058C: ORPHAN_058C: dead code from a patch, followed by the Loran-C phase-code table
(CA F9 = master A / secondary A, 9F AC = master B / secondary B, each preceded by 21H LXI-skip).
059D: PHASE_MISMATCH: B = popcount(PHASE_REF XOR B) = number of phase-code bit errors.
05AF: FIRST_SAMPLE: wait one sample, SAMPLE_CNT = 8, read shift register, SAMPLE_LO = C.
05C2: MATCH_PULSES: walk samples until WIN_END, matching the master phase code
(0CAH on 'A' GRIs, 09FH on 'B' GRIs) and building the pulse-position list.
Entry carry flag selects exact compare (CY=1) or 1-bit-tolerant compare (CY=0).
0665: SAMPLE_TO_BCD: BCD_DELTA_3 = BCD(SAMPLE_CNT - 9).  BIN_TO_DELTA: BCD_DELTA_3 = BCD(A).
0671: COUNT_BITS4: B = popcount of low 4 bits of A.
067F: CHK_NPULSE: carry if CUR_NPULSE bytes >= 6, else zero them.
0698: ADJ_PULSES: pulse-position adjustment; computes a signed 16-bit offset (NEG_HL for
negative) and adds/subtracts BCD_DELTA into BCD_ACC with BCD_ADD4 / BCD_SUB4.
072A: CALC_TD: form the time difference: copy TOA (or GRI) to BCD_ACC, adjust, store to CUR_TOA.
0782: BCD_ADD4: (BC) += (HL), 4 packed-BCD bytes, LS byte first.
PTR_TO_MSB: HL += DE-1, BC += DE-1 (point both at the MS byte).
07BB: COPY4: copy 4 bytes (HL) -> (BC).  COPY_E: copy E bytes.
07D9: BCD_TO_BIN: A = binary value of packed-BCD byte A (uses HI_NIBBLE in the missing half).
07EF: BIN_TO_BCD: A = packed BCD of binary A (0..99). Continues at 0800 in the missing half:
RLC RLC RLC / ADD H / RET.
105C: SLOTREC_UPDATE: bump the per-slot counter, subtract BCD_TMP / 0400H, add popcount, etc.
10DB: CALL_TICK_HOOK: jump through TICK_HOOK (set by the missing half or the monitor).
10DF: SERIAL_POLL: 8251 receive state machine (RX_STATE / PROTO_STATE). See docs/serial-protocol.md.
11EA: MON_CMD: memory monitor commands, active when PROTO_STATE = 3. Char is echoed first.
' ' deposit MON_WORD low byte at (MON_PTR), advance   R back up one address
S set MON_PTR = MON_WORD   G call MON_WORD   M dump memory   K/P/O output mode 1/2/0
0-9 A-F shift hex digit into MON_WORD
12CE: TX_DASH: send '-'. The three LXI H instructions are 21H skip-prefixes over
MVI A,' ' / MVI A,0DH / MVI A,0AH so that entries at 12D1/12D4/12D7 send those chars.
13E7: DISP_REFRESH: write the 8279 display RAM (cmd 90H = write, auto-inc, addr 0).
7 bytes: 3 pairs interleaving high nibbles of 7034..7036 with 7037..7039, then 703A.
Never reached from the dumped halves; called from the missing half.
141F: READ_SWITCHES: read the 6 thumbwheel rows via the 8279 sensor RAM (cmd 50H).
Rows 0,1 -> SEL_A/SEL_B (digit+1, must be 1..9); rows 2..5 -> GRI (first digit >= 4).
Invalid settings call the X_199x error handlers in the missing half and retry.
14B5: SW_TO_DIGIT: convert a sensor row byte to a digit. Rows are 9's-complement BCD on bits 0..5:
digit = 9 - (row & 3FH), valid (carry set) when row & 3FH <= 9. Otherwise returns
14C9: TICK_TASK: run once per RST 7.5 tick. TICK_BCD += 2 (BCD); every 20 ticks call X_19E7.
If RST 5.5 (8279 IRQ) is pending: send End-Interrupt (0E0H) and set KEY_CHANGED;
on a later tick with KEY_CHANGED set, rescan the switches.
14F0: SCAN_SWITCHES: read sensor rows 0..5 and 6..7. Row 0/1 -> SEL_A/SEL_B, rows 2..5 -> SW_D1..4,
SEL_B = 0CH (blank) enters set-up: SW_D1..4 latched to SW_HI/SW_LO; SW_D1 = blank selects
a configuration item by SW_D2: 0-3 baud (110/300/1200/19200), 4-9 OPTIONS bits.
16E0: TX_SERVICE: when OUT_MODE = 0 and 8251 TxRDY, send next char from PRTBUF.

comments.009D: 8155#2: PA out, PB out, PC input, start timer
